# Tool reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-references.mjs — edit runtime/lib/tools.mjs instead -->

Invoke through Reverie's `command_exec` (runtime inside the workspace):

```
node .agents/skills/reverie-motion/runtime/bin/reverie-motion.mjs <command> --project . [--flag value ...]
```

- Flags are the parameter names in kebab-case (`--out-dir`, `--sample-count`). Arrays: repeat the flag or pass a comma list (`--targets css,waapi`). Booleans: `--full` or `--full true`.
- Shorthands: `--param NAME=VALUE` (template params), `--action click:SEL | hover:SEL | play:ID | toggle:ID | flip:ID | flip-reverse:ID | wait:MS`, `--viewport desktop|mobile`, `--story-intent NAME --selector SEL`.
- `--input file.json` supplies the whole input object (explicit flags win). Use it for compose, inline specs, viewports objects and selectors with spaces or `>`.
- Output: one JSON object `{ ok, tool, result }` or `{ ok: false, tool, error: { code, message, ... } }`. Exit 0 ok, 1 tool error, 2 usage/input error. A preview that ran but found problems is still `ok: true` with `result.passed: false`.
- Extra commands: `schema` (all JSON schemas), `doctor [--project .] [--launch]`, `install --project DIR [--scope workspace|user] [--update]`, `mcp` (MCP stdio server exposing the same tools).

## MCP

`reverie-motion mcp` speaks newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 (protocol 2025-06-18 / 2025-03-26 / 2024-11-05): `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call` (result has `content[0].text` JSON and `structuredContent`; `isError` on tool failure), `ping`. Every tool takes `project`.

## `inspect` — motion_inspect_project

Read-only scan of the target project: frameworks, existing motion libraries, styling, reduced-motion coverage, HTML entries, and the export targets that fit the stack. Run first.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Target project directory (default: current directory). All files stay inside it. |

## `templates` — motion_templates

List motion templates (with parameters), style archetypes for style transfer, and narrative intents for storytelling.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Target project directory (default: current directory). All files stay inside it. |

## `design` — motion_design

Create and save a validated MotionSpec revision from a template (+params), a composition of templates, a storytelling intent, or an authored spec. Returns the revision id, validation warnings and a static critique summary.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Target project directory (default: current directory). All files stay inside it. |
| `template` | string | Template id (see motion_templates). |
| `params` | object | Template parameters. |
| `compose` | array | [{template, params}] composed into one spec. |
| `story` | object | {intent, selectors[], totalDurationMs} — OpenMotion narrative planner bound to your selectors. |
| `spec` | string \| object | Spec reference: id (latest revision), id@version, a .json path inside the project, or an inline spec object. |
| `id` | string | Override the spec id (letters, digits, - _). |
| `name` | string |  |

## `variants` — motion_variants

Generate alternative versions of a spec (OpenMotion variant strategies: easing, timing, choreography, intensity, direction; plus native spring-feel variants) and save each as its own spec with a critique score.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Target project directory (default: current directory). All files stay inside it. |
| `spec` **(required)** | string \| object | Spec reference: id (latest revision), id@version, a .json path inside the project, or an inline spec object. |
| `count` | integer | default `3`; min 1; max 8 |
| `strategies` | array | items: easing, timing, choreography, intensity, direction, palette |
| `seed` | integer | default `1` |
| `springFeels` | boolean | default `true` |

## `style` — motion_style

Style intelligence: transfer an archetype's or another spec's motion style (keeps brand colours and one-shot behaviour), synthesize a hybrid from several specs, extract Motion DNA, or compare two specs' DNA.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Target project directory (default: current directory). All files stay inside it. |
| `mode` | string | one of transfer, synthesize, dna, compare, archetypes; default `"transfer"` |
| `spec` | string \| object | Spec reference: id (latest revision), id@version, a .json path inside the project, or an inline spec object. |
| `archetype` | string | minimalist \| energetic \| cinematic \| playful \| corporate \| organic \| mechanical \| elegant |
| `from` | string \| object | Source spec whose style is transferred (transfer) or compared (compare). |
| `sources` | array | Specs whose DNA is blended (synthesize). |
| `strength` | number | default `0.8`; min 0; max 1 |
| `keepColors` | boolean | default `true` |
| `allowLoops` | boolean | default `false` |
| `strategy` | string | one of blend, dominant, crossover, mutation; default `"blend"` |
| `seed` | integer | default `1` |

## `critique` — motion_critique

Static critique of a spec: native UI-motion rules (RM codes with machine fixes) + OpenMotion critique, accessibility, performance and genome analysers. Score 0–100; passed = no critical and score ≥ 70.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Target project directory (default: current directory). All files stay inside it. |
| `spec` **(required)** | string \| object | Spec reference: id (latest revision), id@version, a .json path inside the project, or an inline spec object. |

## `autofix` — motion_autofix

Apply machine fixes for open critique findings (native fixers + OpenMotion auto-fix filtered by a UI policy), save a new revision and report applied/rejected changes with before/after scores.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Target project directory (default: current directory). All files stay inside it. |
| `spec` **(required)** | string \| object | Spec reference: id (latest revision), id@version, a .json path inside the project, or an inline spec object. |
| `passes` | integer | default `3`; min 1; max 5 |

## `preview` — motion_preview

Run motion in a real headless Chromium: runtime errors, frame pacing, layout/style work, layout shift, deterministic keyframe screenshots + element states, visual motion metrics, contact sheet, and a prefers-reduced-motion pass. Works on a spec, a local HTML file, or a localhost URL.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Target project directory (default: current directory). All files stay inside it. |
| `spec` | string \| object | Spec reference: id (latest revision), id@version, a .json path inside the project, or an inline spec object. |
| `file` | string | Local HTML file inside the project. |
| `url` | string | Local URL (localhost/127.0.0.1/*.localhost/*.test); remote needs allowRemote and user consent. |
| `allowRemote` | boolean | default `false` |
| `engine` | string | one of waapi, css; default `"waapi"` |
| `viewports` | array | Viewport names (desktop, mobile) or {name,width,height,deviceScaleFactor,mobile} objects. Default: desktop + mobile. |
| `actions` | array | Interactions before sampling: {type:'click'\|'hover', selector} for any page; {type:'play'\|'reverse'\|'toggle'\|'flip', id, reverse?} for reverie previews; {type:'wait', ms}. |
| `samples` | array | Explicit sample times in ms. |
| `sampleCount` | integer | default `8`; min 2; max 24 |
| `sampleEndMs` | number |  |
| `track` | array | Selectors whose computed state is recorded per sample. |
| `fineTrack` | array | Selectors sampled densely (no screenshots) to verify curves. |
| `fineStepMs` | number | default `16` |
| `reducedMotion` | boolean | Run the prefers-reduced-motion pass. — default `true` |
| `browser` | string | Browser executable override. |
| `full` | boolean | Include the full report inline. — default `false` |

## `export` — motion_export

Write native, dependency-free code for the target project: css, waapi (ES module), react/vue/svelte wrappers, dts typings, standalone html, and optional scaffold markup. Refuses to overwrite unless overwrite=true.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Target project directory (default: current directory). All files stay inside it. |
| `spec` **(required)** | string \| object | Spec reference: id (latest revision), id@version, a .json path inside the project, or an inline spec object. |
| `targets` | array | items: css, waapi, react, vue, svelte, dts, html, scaffold; default `css, waapi` |
| `outDir` | string | Directory inside the project. — default `"src/motion"` |
| `fileBase` | string | Base file name (default: spec id). |
| `includeStyles` | boolean | Also emit component static styles in the CSS. — default `false` |
| `overwrite` | boolean | default `false` |

## `verify` — motion_verify

Closed loop: critique → auto-fix (new revision when needed) → real-browser preview, repeated up to maxRounds until both static and runtime checks pass. Returns every round and the final verdict.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Target project directory (default: current directory). All files stay inside it. |
| `spec` **(required)** | string \| object | Spec reference: id (latest revision), id@version, a .json path inside the project, or an inline spec object. |
| `engine` | string | one of waapi, css; default `"waapi"` |
| `viewports` | array | Viewport names (desktop, mobile) or {name,width,height,deviceScaleFactor,mobile} objects. Default: desktop + mobile. |
| `actions` | array | Interactions before sampling: {type:'click'\|'hover', selector} for any page; {type:'play'\|'reverse'\|'toggle'\|'flip', id, reverse?} for reverie previews; {type:'wait', ms}. |
| `autofix` | boolean | default `true` |
| `maxRounds` | integer | default `2`; min 1; max 4 |

## `lineage` — motion_lineage

Revision history of all specs in the project (OpenMotion lineage engine, persisted): operations, parents, generations and an optional focus report for one revision.

| Parameter | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | Target project directory (default: current directory). All files stay inside it. |
| `spec` | string | Optional revision id (id@version) to focus on. |

## Style archetypes

| id | Description | Spring feel used for spring components |
|---|---|---|
| `minimalist` | Sparse, calm, single-axis motion with neutral palette. | response 0.35, dampingFraction 1 |
| `energetic` | Fast, bouncy, high-density motion with saturated colors. | response 0.32, dampingFraction 0.6 |
| `cinematic` | Slow, ceremonial, layered motion with deep palette. | response 0.7, dampingFraction 0.95 |
| `playful` | Bouncy, rotating, multi-color motion with loops. | response 0.45, dampingFraction 0.5 |
| `corporate` | Predictable, measured motion with restrained palette. | response 0.4, dampingFraction 1 |
| `organic` | Spring-driven, irregular, natural-feeling motion. | response 0.6, dampingFraction 0.75 |
| `mechanical` | Linear, precise, robotic motion with no overshoot. | switches to bezier timing |
| `elegant` | Slow, smooth, symmetric motion with refined palette. | response 0.55, dampingFraction 0.9 |

## Narrative intents (storytelling)

| intent | Description |
|---|---|
| `hero-entrance` | A dramatic introduction where the hero element arrives with authority and presence. |
| `celebration` | A joyous, energetic sequence of motion celebrating an achievement or milestone. |
| `dramatic-reveal` | A slow, tension-building sequence culminating in a dramatic reveal of hidden content. |
| `conflict` | A tense sequence where opposing forces clash, creating visual tension and dramatic friction. |
| `transformation` | A metamorphic sequence where an element evolves from one state to another. |
| `journey` | A hero's journey from departure through challenge to return, told through motion. |
| `resolution` | A peaceful, concluding sequence that brings closure and calm after intensity. |
